items.label: Elegant Bracelet Watch
items.value: This women's vintage quartz watch features a delicate 0.67*0.91in oval dial with roman numerals, paired with a unique chain bracelet strap, offering the look of jewelry and the practicality of a timepiece. A sophisticated aesthetic that effortlessly complements both casual and formal ensembles.

items.label: Premium Materials
items.value: Built with a quality alloy steel case and bracelet band, the dainty oval watch for women provides excellent wearing experience, complemented by a hardened mineral glass that resists scratches and maintains long-lasting clarity. Powered by a precise quartz movement, this elegant ladies dress watch ensures accurate timekeeping.

items.label: Lightweight & Comfortable Fit
items.value: Weighing only 25.3g with a slim 0.25in (6.5mm) rhinestones setting band width, this women's gold bracelet watch provides all-day comfort without bulk. The 8.27in (210mm) strap length ensures a secure and elegant fit for most wrist sizes.

items.label: Thoughtful Gift for Her
items.value: The feminine & luxury women's wristwatch makes a beautiful gift for mom, wife, girlfriend, or friends on birthdays, anniversaries, weddings or Christmas. With the included tool, you can easily adjust the strap to fit wrist.

items.label: 30M Waterproof
items.value: Water resistant to rain, hand washing, splash, brief immersion in water, offering reliable performance for everyday use. Avoid pressing any buttons while in water to maintain optimal functionality.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Easy Reader, Lightweight, Roman Numeral, Scratch-Resistant, Second Hand
